prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，了解其职称、出诊时间和擅长领域。","reading":"读者通常先定位科室，再逐行比较医生、出诊时间与专长；合并的科室单元格将同科医生组织成组，每位医生的一行应保持清晰可辨。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同标识医生及其专业资历。","出诊时间和擅长领域共同帮助患者判断何时就诊以及医生是否适合自己的病情。"],"keep_intact":["医生姓名和职称应尽量保持在一行。","出诊时间中的单个星期与时段组合应保持完整，便于准确识别。","科室名称应尽量保持完整，尤其是合并单元格中的科室名称。"],"may_wrap":["擅长领域是较长的连续描述，可在自然语义位置换行，并利用每位医生行内增加的高度。","出诊时间可在不同出诊时段之间换行；专长描述造成的行高通常可以容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [98, 67, 98, 90, 366] · table 720×640px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [98, 67, 98, 113, 343] · table 720×640px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [98, 67, 98, 150, 306] · table 720×779px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"科室、姓名和职称均保持单行；专长列宽裕，多数医生的专长用三行呈现，合并科室单元格也清楚地组织了各组。","problems":"出诊时间多次把“上午”“下午”或“全天”拆到两行，甚至将同一时段分成三行，患者难以快速识别。","cause":"出诊时间列仅90px，扣除内边距后约69px，不能容纳完整的星期与时段组合及相邻标点。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"科室、姓名和职称保持单行；专长列仍有足够宽度，多数行高与r2A相同，整体较紧凑。","problems":"出诊时间仍在星期与时段组合内部断行，如“周／四下午”，使两次出诊的边界不清楚；专长列的部分短语也被挤到下一行。","cause":"出诊时间列113px虽比r2A宽，但不足以同时容纳第一时段、分隔符及第二时段；浏览器按可用宽度换行，没有保证第二个组合完整。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"身份信息和科室分组仍清楚，较宽的时间列使第一出诊时段容易读取。","problems":"第二个出诊时段仍被拆开，常只剩“午”或“天”落在下一行；专长列变窄后，每位医生的描述都占四行，整表明显增高，行内空白也随之增加。","cause":"出诊时间列150px接近但未达到两段时间的单行宽度，第二段因此在末尾断开；专长列缩至306px，触发了更多换行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整时间","widths":[98,67,98,159,297],"change":"将出诊时间列增至159px，按给定内容宽度138px加21px边距容纳完整时间；专长列相应收窄，验证时间完整性与表高之间的取舍。"},{"name":"均衡双行","widths":[98,67,98,105,351],"change":"将出诊时间列调整至105px，尝试让每个星期与时段组合各占一行，同时把更多宽度留给专长；需通过渲染确认标点与换行位置。"},{"name":"宽专长双行","widths":[98,67,98,99,357],"change":"进一步收窄时间列至99px，测试其是否仍能容纳单个完整出诊时段，并为专长描述争取更多空间。"}]}
